    Supplied layout reference

    Reference geometry guides the reconstruction. Elevations and movement timing remain illustrative.
    Model basis & remaining precision limits

    Layout basis: embedded CAD linework from your supplied flow model, cross-checked against your annotated layout. Reserve banks, active areas, Locus bridge, tower, VAS, staging and dock sides follow that reference.

    Reported site figures: 20 Locus AMRs; 4 Stretch robots, with 3 dock positions active; 12,768 active locations; 43,300 reserve locations. Rendered rack bays and cartons are representative, not a location-by-location inventory.

    Still illustrative: rack height, tower elevations, machine footprints, bridge clearances, conveyor connections, dock assignments and movement timing. CAD linework is not independently checked against the DWG scale. No throughput, utilization or cycle-time prediction is produced.

    Lane reconciliation: this model follows your later lane description: 1–6 LTL/FTL; 7 exceptions / international / parcels; 8 USPS / UPS; 9 FedEx Ground. The older brief describing all nine as LTL remains a conflict to close.

    Process rules retained for the future calibrated model: masterpack replenishment; >5 replenishments triggers pallet-location review; top-40 Specialty placement; missing dimensions delay slotting; unslotted orders block waves. These rules are not converted into invented operating rates here.

    Custom WebGL / Canvas visualization · no measured distance or performance claim. Keyboard on scene: arrows pan, +/− zoom, Home fits, Space pauses. Restart resets holds and multipliers.
